Sole · Lakeshore theme

Dusk over the lake, with a footprint for a sun.

An original icon and app theme inspired by the colors and bold black outlines of the painting you shared: night‑teal sky, a burnt‑orange sun, pine green, lake blue and bark brown. Liquid Glass stays on the tab bar and buttons, as in the v2 design.

App icon

A footprint in front of the setting sun, framed by pines and a lake with cattails. Thick black outlines and flat color fields follow the painting's style; the figures are new, so nothing is copied from the artwork. iOS 26 adds its own glass edge and makes the dark and tinted versions from this one image.

Today, day and night

The background is a quiet lakeshore: sky, a pine ridge and the lake. The sun glow rises as your steps approach your goal. Cards keep a solid fill and gain a bold outline, so numbers stay easy to read.

Palette

Each color has a light and a dark value (left and right half). Health data still never turns red: "worth a look" stays amber, taken from the cattails.
